# Model 

Suppose we want to perform binary classification on some data. 

```{r}
d1 <- rnorm(100, mean = 5, sd = 1)
d2 <- rnorm(100, mean = 4.5, sd = 1)
df <- tibble(d1, d2) %>% pivot_longer(cols = d1:d2)
df %>% head(5)
```

Let's try a simple linear model: 

```{r}
simple_linear_regression <- lm(value ~ name, df)
summary(simple_linear_regression)
```

Let's plot this! 

```{r}
df %>% ggplot(aes(y = value, x= name)) +
  geom_point(alpha = .4) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm") +
  labs(y = "Default (1 = yes, 0 = no)",
       title = "Default outcome by balance") +
  theme_minimal()

```
